compute_environment: dot cloud only; no Mac or remote executor calls
identity: (source, original record_id); no id-only deduplication; identity is metadata only
row_policy: all source rows, raw order and values retained; no resampling, balancing or filtering
parameters: historical settings frozen per method; only necessary dimension/phase-ID adaptation, disclosed in each runner protocol
kernel_bandwidth: preserve historical h=(4/(d+2)/n)^(1/(d+4)) where applicable, using actual reference n; original algorithm, not fixed-bandwidth controlled experiment
extra_ablation_policy: No unrequested fixed-n/fixed-bandwidth/seed-expanded Cartesian grid. The already-produced fixed-phase-bin TAPAS companion is clearly separated and does not justify duplicating other methods.
TAPAS_bins: Primary: fit decile boundaries on each selected BG, keeping historical decile count and smoothing fixed. Already-produced phase-original-fixed-bin results are separately labelled limited controlled companions, not primary.
historical_18_target_panels: label separately as legacy regression checks; never substitute for requested all20
prelim_evaluation: read released membership truth only after all current-run prediction artifacts and protocol are hashed/frozen; all-record and nonrare metric scopes labelled explicitly; retain historical metric/tie definition
historical_supervision: retain original supervised folds and labels only where historical method intrinsically trained on them; distinguish training labels from heldout/evaluation-only truth; never label those methods wholly truth-blind
main_evaluation: no membership truth, no TPR, FPR or AUC; rank/score/shape/stability QA only; do not invent main-trained variants
heldout_Q: preserve each historical method split definition; phase-present fixed IDs only, own target excluded; record exact fold membership and population
method_inventory: separately frozen by inventory worker and each execution runner; this input protocol does not invent or silently drop methods
inference_constraints: do not use exact observed label counts or truth-derived choices; public-design capacities may be preserved and dimensionally adapted
output_policy: new staged descendants of 攻撃フェーズ/Tashiro/ only; no changes to original official input files or old results
interpretation: exploratory retrospective preliminary evaluation, not independent validation; pooled-size, adaptive-bandwidth and C copied-BG content can all affect comparisons
revision_reason: Primary complete background substitution includes selected-BG fitted preprocessing; row/signature overlap counts separately audited.
BG_derived_fit_policy: Primary runs refit every background-derived quantity on selected BG: IQR/scales, category frequencies, covariance/whitening, TAPAS decile bins and other fit statistics; fixed historical hyperparameters and folds remain unchanged.
public_Q_policy: Public known-nonmember Q calibration cohorts remain historical phase inputs; they are not substituted with BG.
